decisions.statement: A readout feed admits a device secret or a signed-in session.
A request carrying no device secret header is read as a session.
A signed-in contributor is read off the request before any account is.
A request carrying a device secret is read by that secret and by nothing else.
A reader admitted either way must hold readout access.
The widget carries a device secret and the app's web view carries a session.

definition: a readout request refused unless the reader is known and holds readout access
